entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt., Lucknow And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Devendra Pratap Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anita Singh Nagore Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for respondent no.2 and learned A.G.A. for respondent State.

The present application has been filed by the applicant namely Aditya @ Rohit @ Aditya Pratap Singh for quashing of the impugned criminal proceedings in Case Crime No.0258 of 2020 under Section 384, 420, 506, 509, 411 I.P.C., Police Station Talkatora, District Lucknow.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that dispute between the applicant and respondent nos.2 and 3 have been amicably settled outside the court by way of compromise.

A copy of compromise Aditya @ Rohit @ Aditya Pratap Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt., ... on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124734853/
1 deed is annexed as Annexure-1 to the application.

entities.text: Aditya @ Rohit @ Aditya Pratap Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for respondent no.2 does not dispute the above facts rather he concedes the same.
It is jointly prayed by the parties' counsel that on the basis of compromise the proceedings impugned are liable to be quashed.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection, however, he submits that it will be appropriate that compromise is verified first by the competent court and only then any further orders may be passed.

On due consideration of the arguments advanced by the parties' counsel and perusal of the record and considering the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Gian Singh vs.
State of Punjab, 2012 AIR SCW 5333, the petition is disposed of directing the parties to appear along with the original compromise deed before the learned trial court on 1.5.2024 for verification of the compromise.

sentences.text: Learned trial court shall verify the contents of the compromise in the presence of parties within a period of two weeks' thereafter and provide a copy of verification report to the parties.

It will be open for the applicant to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings by filing a fresh petition along with verification report given by the learned trial court and also the compromise entered between the parties.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that dispute between the applicant and respondent nos.2 and 3 have been amicably settled outside the court by way of compromise.

opennyai_summary.decision:
It is jointly prayed by the parties' counsel that on the basis of compromise the proceedings impugned are liable to be quashed.
On due consideration of the arguments advanced by the parties' counsel and perusal of the record and considering the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of Gian Singh vs.
State of Punjab, 2012 AIR SCW 5333, the petition is disposed of directing the parties to appear along with the original compromise deed before the learned trial court on 1.5.2024 for verification of the compromise.
